translations.web: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
translations.bsb: You must be sure to set aside a tenth of all the produce brought forth each year from your fields.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
translations.asv: Thou shalt surely tithe all the increase of thy seed, that which cometh forth from the field year by year.
